title: Flashdance
tagline: Welder by day. Dancer by night.
about: An 18-year-old Pittsburgh steel mill welder dances at a neighbourhood bar at night and works up the nerve to audition for the dance conservatory.
cue: Serve the lobster when Alex and Nick sit down to dinner.
faces: Richie quits the grill for LA stand-up. Potato and cheese pierogies with fried onions.
Alex welds at the steel mill by day. Hot buffalo wings with blue cheese dip.
He didn't call. Then he called.
Nick grew up on hand-me-down lunches. Grilled lobster tails, garlic butter and shoestring fries.
Johnny C. wants her at the Zanzibar. Steak, provolone, vinegar slaw and chips, all in the bread.

Jeanie falls twice on the ice. Vanilla ice cream, hot fudge and toasted almonds.
